components.css: :host{--ground:#050505;--stock:#0d0c0b;--stock-2:#151311;--rule:rgba(171,86,43,.42);--rule-soft:rgba(171,86,43,.2);--rust:#ab562b;--rust-text:#db8150;--seafoam:#40bf9d;--paper:#f3eee7;--muted:#aaa197;--display:'House of Cards','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;--text:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;--ease:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);} .ds-sheet{background:var(--stock);color:var(--paper);} .ds-row{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px minmax(0,1.25fr) minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:20px;align-items:center;width:100%;min-height:68px;padding:0 24px 0 0;background:none;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule-soft);color:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:background .25s;} .ds-row::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 64px;border-left:1px solid var(--rule);} .ds-row:hover{background:var(--stock-2);} .ds-row[aria-pressed=true]{background:rgba(171,86,43,.1);} .ds-row:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--seafoam);outline-offset:-2px;} .ds-row__no{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;font:600 18px/1 var(--text);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--muted);} .ds-row[aria-pressed=true] .ds-row__no{color:var(--paper);} .ds-ring{position:absolute;width:54px;height:40px;left:50%;top:50%;translate:-50% -50%;fill:none;stroke:var(--seafoam);stroke-width:2.4;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-dasharray:150;stroke-dashoffset:150;opacity:0;transition:stroke-dashoffset .5s var(--ease);} .ds-row[aria-pressed=true] .ds-ring{opacity:1;stroke-dashoffset:0;} .ds-row__name{font:700 26px/1 var(--display);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.01em;padding:18px 0;} .ds-row__pos{font:400 16px/1.15 var(--display);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--rust-text);}

components.css: :host{--ground:#050505;--stock:#0d0c0b;--stock-2:#151311;--rule:rgba(171,86,43,.42);--rule-soft:rgba(171,86,43,.2);--rust:#ab562b;--rust-text:#db8150;--seafoam:#40bf9d;--paper:#f3eee7;--muted:#aaa197;--display:'House of Cards','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;--text:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;--ease:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);} .ds-photos{position:relative;max-width:300px;margin:16px 16px 40px 32px;} .ds-print{background:var(--paper);padding:8px;box-shadow:0 18px 36px -14px rgba(0,0,0,.85);} .ds-img{aspect-ratio:4/5;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#3a2414,#1a120d);} .ds-img--s{aspect-ratio:3/4;} .ds-snap{position:absolute;left:-14px;bottom:-22px;width:34%;margin:0;background:var(--paper);padding:6px 6px 0;box-shadow:0 14px 28px -10px rgba(0,0,0,.8);} .ds-snap figcaption{font:400 11px/1 var(--display);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#2a211b;padding:7px 0 6px;text-align:center;}

narrative.overview:
The LPA brand (black ground, rust, seafoam, House of Cards, the shield and arch wordmark) is printed onto a single sheet of black card stock. Content is laid out the way a lineup card is: ruled rows, column heads, a numbered left gutter, rust section bands, and a printed footer. Information is dense and tabular on purpose, so the whole staff reads at a glance as one roster. Photographs are physical objects on the card: paper-bordered prints, and a smaller snapshot overlapping the main print.

Depth comes from the sheet itself. The card sits on a near-black ground with one soft drop shadow, and its interior is flat, divided by thin rust rules and double rules. Every printed label, name and heading is set in House of Cards capitals. Running copy, credentials and numerals use the system sans so long reading stays easy. Seafoam is the hand-drawn mark: it circles the selected row and draws the focus ring, and appears nowhere else in the CSS.

Motion is short and physical. A new selection draws the seafoam ring around its number, wipes the portrait in from the card's edge, drops the snapshot, and lifts the name and credentials into place. Reduced-motion turns all of it off.
keyCharacteristics: Black card stock (stock) on a darker ground, edged by a 1px rust rule.
Rust works as print: rules, section bands, the primary button, and small type in its lighter text tint.
House of Cards uppercase for every printed label. System sans for reading.
Seafoam is used only for the selection mark and the focus ring.
Photos look like prints: paper border, soft drop shadow, overlapping snapshot.

rules.name: The Marker Rule
rules.body: Seafoam is the pen, not the print. In CSS it marks only selection and focus. Every printed element is rust, paper or grey.

rules.name: The Rust Legibility Rule
rules.body: Use rust as a fill, as a rule, or for display-size type. Small text on black uses rust-text.

rules.name: The Printed Label Rule
rules.body: Anything printed on the card (heads, names, positions, bands, buttons, nav) is House of Cards uppercase. Anything someone reads as prose is system sans in sentence case.

rules.name: The Tracking Ladder Rule
rules.body: The smaller the label, the wider the tracking: 0.01em for names, 0.06–0.08em for 16–20px labels, 0.12–0.18em for 13–16px heads and bands.

rules.name: The Objects-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to paper objects on the card, never to rows, bands, buttons or text. Structure is drawn with rust rules.

dos: **Do** draw structure with rust rules (1px at 42%, 20% between entries, 3px double at major divisions) instead of boxes or shadows.
**Do** set every printed label in House of Cards uppercase, and prose in system sans.
**Do** use rust-text (#db8150) for any rust text under display size.
**Do** reserve seafoam for the selection ring and the 2px focus outline (3px offset).
**Do** mount photographs as paper prints with a paper border and a soft downward shadow.
**Do** keep corners square and touch targets at least 44px.
**Do** keep the LPA shield in the site bar and the rust arch wordmark in the site footer.
donts: **Don't** set small rust (#ab562b) text on black. It measures 3.8:1.
**Don't** use seafoam as a fill, a band, a button or decoration.
**Don't** round corners or put shadows on rows, bands or buttons.
**Don't** replace House of Cards with another display face, or set body copy in it.
